Provenance
==========

Origin: SYNTHETIC (hand-authored)
Date:   2026-05-20
Author: costa (B3 Phase 1 — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-20-screenshot-e2e-snapshot-tests.md)

Why synthetic rather than a real github.com capture:

  Phase 1 is the "Foundation" deliverable. It proves the route-redirect
  architecture works against ONE platform. A minimal synthetic fixture
  satisfies that goal in <1 KB while keeping the DOM contract identical
  to what HOST_MAIN_SELECTORS expects:

    article.markdown-body  (target — main readme content)
    .file-tree             (decoy — must NOT win matching)
    .sidebar-meta          (decoy — same)
    .AppHeader             (decoy — top nav)

  Phase 2 captures real public pages for the remaining ~14 entries in
  HOST_MAIN_SELECTORS using `_capture.py` (TBD). Real captures inline
  100 KB - 2 MB of vendor CSS / inlined images per file — acceptable
  cost spread across releases, not Phase 1.

If GitHub redesigns its DOM and the production selector
(`article.markdown-body`) no longer matches, the fixture should be
re-authored (or replaced with a fresh capture) in a SEPARATE PR from
any production selector change — otherwise the test's regression net
is bypassed.

SHA-256 of repo-readme.html (auto-generated; do not edit manually):
  (computed in CI; see tests/test_screenshot_e2e.py if drift detected)
